problem_text:
A logistics company needs to coordinate 8 delivery trucks to transport goods to 8 different distribution centers.

Each truck must follow a predetermined route represented as pairs (Distribution Center, Loading/Unloading time),
where each pair specifies the distribution center where the truck must stop and the time required for loading/unloading operations.
The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which the distribution centers must be visited.

Truck schedules:
* Truck 1 follows: (DC3, 1) → (DC7, 10) → (DC8, 4) → (DC4, 10) → (DC6, 1) → (DC2, 8) → (DC1, 1) → (DC5, 7)
* Truck 2 follows: (DC3, 8) → (DC7, 6) → (DC2, 9) → (DC1, 7) → (DC6, 8) → (DC4, 6) → (DC8, 5) → (DC5, 9)
* Truck 3 follows: (DC5, 5) → (DC4, 1) → (DC8, 4) → (DC3, 8) → (DC7, 5) → (DC6, 7) → (DC2, 7) → (DC1, 3)
* Truck 4 follows: (DC3, 10) → (DC4, 3) → (DC2, 8) → (DC6, 2) → (DC5, 8) → (DC1, 4) → (DC7, 7) → (DC8, 3)
* Truck 5 follows: (DC2, 10) → (DC7, 3) → (DC1, 3) → (DC5, 10) → (DC6, 4) → (DC3, 6) → (DC4, 6) → (DC8, 2)
* Truck 6 follows: (DC2, 10) → (DC4, 10) → (DC7, 8) → (DC8, 10) → (DC3, 5) → (DC6, 2) → (DC1, 3) → (DC5, 7)
* Truck 7 follows: (DC2, 6) → (DC6, 3) → (DC8, 8) → (DC7, 6) → (DC5, 9) → (DC3, 2) → (DC4, 2) → (DC1, 7)
* Truck 8 follows: (DC1, 10) → (DC8, 2) → (DC2, 6) → (DC3, 2) → (DC4, 8) → (DC7, 10) → (DC6, 8) → (DC5, 5)

Each loading/unloading operation must be completed without interruption once it begins,
and each distribution center can only accommodate one truck at a time for these operations.
The objective is to schedule all truck operations at the distribution centers
so that the total completion time for all deliveries is minimized.
